claims.claim: On 2026-10-29 ICE and Trade[XYZ] announced a definitive agreement under which ICE becomes exclusive operator of Trade[XYZ]'s regulated markets, subject to regulatory approvals, with no regulator named.
The ICE release does not state where order matching for the onshore market will occur; it says the structure will be built on Hyperliquid.
Trade[XYZ] is a HIP-3 builder whose markets currently match, position and settle on HyperCore.
Wilson's 2026-10-30 post asked five questions including whether Hyperliquid priority fees fit CFTC core principles and whether positions being trackable in real time is a benefit.
Hyperliquid order priority latency improves linearly from 0 to 8 bps at roughly 45 ms per bp, ALO orders are sorted within a 400 ms window, and priority fees are burned.
Hyperliquid gossip priority is a Dutch auction on a 3-minute schedule with a 0.1 HYPE floor buying about 25 ms of earlier read access per slot.
Lighter Standard accounts pay 0/0 fees with 300 ms taker and cancel latency, while Premium accounts pay 0.0040% maker and 0.0280% taker with 140 ms taker latency.
L2BEAT rates Lighter Stage 0, with a 21-day regular upgrade delay that a 4/7 Security Council can reduce to zero, and 91 upgrades at fetch time.
If the operator does not process a forced priority transaction for 14 days, anyone can trigger desert mode and users prove balances against the last state root to withdraw.
L2BEAT rebuilt the desert verifier byte-for-byte and reproduced the state root from blobs across about 5,000 batches.
Open positions cash-settle at the last published mark price on exit, and oracle signatures are not verified onchain.
L2BEAT records average proof intervals of about 3m41s, state updates about 6m53s, and a stall of more than four hours on 2026-10-29.
zkSecurity's audit of Lighter's block circuits found two high-severity issues, one letting a malicious prover create an account with arbitrary collateral; all but one finding were fixed.

Regulation 38.151 requires impartial, non-discriminatory access criteria and comparable fee structures for equal access; Core Principle 9 requires a competitive, open, and efficient market; Core Principle 12 requires promotion of fair and equitable trading.
A foreign board of trade may not permit direct access to its electronic trading and order matching system from the US without a Part 48 registration.
On 2026-05-29 the CFTC approved Kalshi's BTCPERP as a futures contract under Regulation 40.3 and said the perpetual design may not be suitable for all asset classes.
CFTC staff Letter 26-17 lets Coinbase's FCM offer offshore perps as foreign futures and accept digital commodities or stablecoins as margin at a foreign affiliate.
Paradex posts encrypted blobs under a symmetric key encrypted to a three-member council and L2BEAT states there is no generic escape hatch mechanism.
Hyperliquid 30-day perp volume was about $209.5B and Lighter's about $62.7B as of 2026-10-15, with open interest of $7.70B and $711M.
A snapshot as of about 2026-09-28 put total itemised 30-day on-chain perp volume near $598B with Hyperliquid at $204.1B and Lighter at $52.6B.
An autopsy of the 2025-10-10 crash put total market-wide liquidations above $19B.
Lighter was offline about 4.5 hours during the 2025-10-10 cascade after a database failure, affecting over 2,000 users.
A 21Shares note in October 2025 raised the possibility of wash trading in incentive-driven perp volume and applied its 70:1 volume-to-TVL flag to Aster rather than Lighter.
Bankless identified Will Price as a DeFi investor and Lighter advisor on 2026-06-02.
